info.description: One uniformed group on Beyond Academics → NCC, Scouts & Guides. ⚠ `slug` IS THE PAGE ANCHOR (#ncc, #scouts-guides) and may be linked from outside the site — rename the group freely, but change the slug only if you mean to break those links. ⚠⚠ EVERY FACT ON THIS PAGE HAS A SOURCE, and `verified` on each fact is what says whether it is the school describing itself or something independently evidenced. A claim about OTHER schools — "first in the district", "first of its kind" — must stay unverified so the page keeps attributing it.
